# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Runtime performance and stability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves rendering responsiveness, memory retention, and managed interop performance across supported platforms. Android texture rendering now follows display refresh, while pixel operations and text shaping avoid avoidable work. WebGPU support is included directly in native artifacts, and front-buffered streams no longer retain more data than necessary.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering synchronized with display refresh** — Texture-backed Android rendering now coordinates presentation with the display refresh cycle, improving visual responsiveness. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Front-buffered streams release retained data** — Front-buffered stream handling no longer retains buffered content unnecessarily, reducing memory pressure for consumers that read streams incrementally. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed image pixel copies optimized** — Managed image pixel-copy paths avoid unnecessary work, improving throughput when applications move pixel data between SkiaSharp and managed buffers. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Text shaping reduces temporary allocations** — HarfBuzz text input reuses UTF-32 buffers, and feature-string processing no longer allocates native memory while preserving existing decoding behavior. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **WebGPU implementation ships in native artifacts** — The native SkiaSharp library now includes emdawnwebgpu's WebGPU implementation, making the required support available with the shipped artifact. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
